open_points.subject: create replay after an ordinary change to the created record
open_points.text: This holds while the record the first create made keeps its values
open_points.question: If the first-created project, customer or room still exists but one of its mutable facts or marks has changed, does repeating its create remain a replay of that record, become a new create, or get refused?
options: Return the existing record in its current state
Treat the request as a new create and mint a second record
Refuse because the original record no longer equals the create request
open_points.default_guess: Return the existing record in its current state because its create request id still survives.

witness.initial: Customer C was recorded with request id R and is unrestricted.
events: The owner repeats the original record-customer request with request id R.
outcomes: Registry recognizes the replay and returns the existing restricted Customer C.
Because C no longer keeps its original values, Registry treats the call as a new create and mints an unrestricted Customer C2.
witness.observer: The owner, and any project action that can subsequently name C2

open_points.subject: project-create replay after whole project deletion
open_points.text: Erasing a customer or anonymising a project removes everything that would tell a repeat ...; a create repeated after that is a new create
open_points.question: What happens when a project-create request is repeated after the owner chose whole deletion rather than anonymisation?
options: Treat it as a new create and mint a new project
Retain enough replay knowledge to return or refuse the repeat
Refuse the repeat because the former project was deleted
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a new create because whole deletion leaves even less replay evidence than anonymisation.

witness.initial: Project P was created by request R and is active.
events: The owner confirms whole deletion of P.
The owner repeats create request R.
outcomes: Registry treats R as a new create and mints active project P2.
Registry does not create P2 because the stated exception covers anonymisation but not whole deletion.
witness.observer: The owner and every consumer of the project catalogue

open_points.subject: normal create preconditions on a post-anonymisation replay
open_points.text: a create repeated after that is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made
open_points.question: Does a repeated project create after anonymisation still apply the current new-create preconditions, even when they now fail, or must it make the new record promised by this passage?
options: Apply current create preconditions and refuse when the referenced customer is now erased, restricted or ended
Always make the new record described by the new passage
Make the record only when all current create preconditions still hold
open_points.default_guess: Apply all current create preconditions; the passage's promise of a made record applies only to a repeat that remains otherwise valid.

witness.initial: Active Customer C exists, and project P linked to C was created by request R.
events: The owner archives and anonymises P.
The owner erases C's contact data.
The owner repeats project-create request R, which still names C.
outcomes: The new passage makes a new project and the answer shows it.
The primary create action refuses the request because its customer reference is erased, so no new project exists.
